name: Latent Code Optimization for X-ray to CT Reconstruction
aliases: Latent Code Optimization for Single-View X-ray to 3D Reconstruction
definition: A method to reconstruct a 3D CT volume from a single 2D X-ray projection by optimizing the latent code $z$ of a pre-trained conditional NeRF generator, rather than optimizing the network weights. The goal is to find a latent vector $z$ such that the rendered X-ray projection from the generator matches the input target X-ray image.
summary: Latent Code Optimization for X-ray to CT Reconstruction reconstructs 3D volumes from single 2D X-rays by optimizing a pre-trained NeRF's latent code instead of network weights.
